title: Entry points: only allow `=` as field delimiter
author: woodruffw
body_preview: Per [the Entry Points specification](https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/specifications/entry-points/#file-format), the `entry_points.txt` file should always use `=` as a delimiter, not `:`. We currently accept both, since that's the default in the `configparser` crate.  (This is a minor issue, just something we could better align with the spec on.)
